_doc: Labeled tool-selection eval set. Each case: a natural-language task (as the owner would phrase it), the gold tool, and acceptable alternates (genuinely correct substitutes). Deterministic labels - no LLM judge needed for the retrieval metrics. Queries are written independently of the toolsearch alias map; do not tune aliases to these strings.
